fmcg.detection_hint: a supplement/wellness bottle, jar, tub, sachet, gummy pack, skincare tube/jar, or similar packaged consumer good

A.name: Hero Product + Ingredient Orbit
A.description: The product stands large and centered in the frame. Benefit and ingredient callouts orbit it on all sides — upper corners for the strongest benefit claims, lower corners for hero ingredients — with pack information sitting quietly near the bottom. Generous negative space keeps the product dominant.

B.name: Editorial Product
B.description: A single vertical reading flow: key benefit at the top, one ingredient callout, the product itself centered, another ingredient callout, pack size at the bottom. Minimal, restrained, premium — the callouts read top-to-bottom like an editorial column rather than scattering around the frame.

C.name: Ingredient Story
C.description: A narrative vertical chain: an ingredient flows down into the product flanked on both sides by its two hero ingredients, which flows down into the primary benefit, which flows down into the pack size — visually telling the story of what real ingredients went into the product and what they do.

typography.notes: Compact, elegant, secondary to the product. Clear hierarchy: primary callout at medium emphasis, secondary callout small, pack information smallest as metadata. Short phrases, never sentences. Text should occupy less visual area than the product. Rotation must be intentional, never applied randomly to every text element.

visual_rules: Product/package must remain visually dominant
Ingredients should visually support the product, not compete with it
Ingredients should be placed naturally around the product
Use real-looking ingredient representation rather than generic icons whenever possible
Avoid excessive ingredient duplication
Use negative space around the product
Keep text short
Use 3-6 major information groups
Use thin leader lines when connecting information to ingredients
Use subtle typography
Do not cover important packaging information
Avoid placing text over visually busy ingredients
Use natural surfaces/backgrounds when appropriate to the product
Background should support the product story, not distract from it
Do not create a crowded scientific diagram unless explicitly requested
fmcg.copy_pattern: Benefit-led, not feature-led: a short noun phrase naming the claim or ingredient (e.g. 'Natural Energy Support', 'Himalayan Shilajit'), never a full sentence. Prefer specific, verifiable facts over generic praise.

clothing.detection_hint: an adult or children's garment (shirt, hoodie, dress, jacket, saree, denim, etc.), worn, hung, or laid flat

A.name: Garment Hero + Callouts
A.description: The garment sits centered and dominant. Fabric, neckline, sleeve, and silhouette callouts fan out around it, each connected by a thin leader line — a catalog/product-image feel that stays editorial rather than technical.

B.name: Editorial Annotation
B.description: A single elegant vertical column: fabric, garment, neckline, sleeve, fit/silhouette — refined, well-spaced, minimal, reading top-to-bottom like a fashion editorial caption rather than a spec sheet.

C.name: Fabric + Detail Story
C.description: Opens on the fabric texture itself, flows into the garment shot, then branches into close-up detail zooms (buttons, stitching, embroidery, cuffs, print) on either side, with fit/silhouette captioned at the bottom — built to show off fabric quality and construction detail.

typography.notes: Editorial fashion aesthetic: small, clean, refined, well-spaced, minimal. Avoid oversized promotional typography. Typography reads as annotation, not headline content. Each annotation stays visually separated from the garment. Text may sit at different angles for an editorial composition, but readability must stay high.

visual_rules: The garment must remain the dominant visual subject
Never make a clothing infographic look like a technical engineering diagram unless a technical spec style is explicitly requested
Communicate visual identity, material characteristics, construction details, silhouette and styling through minimal editorial annotations
The visual language should resemble premium fashion editorial/product communication
Show fabric through actual texture representation, not just a text label (see material_visual_map)
Use thin leader lines where necessary
Keep each annotation visually separated from the garment and from other annotations
clothing.copy_pattern: Short noun phrases naming a construction detail or material spec (e.g. 'LIGHTWEIGHT SATIN', 'SWEETHEART NECKLINE'), read as annotation rather than headline copy.

cosmetics.detection_hint: a cosmetics/makeup/beauty product — compact, tube, bottle, or palette

food.detection_hint: a packaged food product — box, pouch, jar, or wrapped item

jewellery.detection_hint: a ring, necklace, earring, bracelet, or other jewellery piece

footwear.detection_hint: a shoe, sandal, boot, or other footwear item

accessories.detection_hint: a bag, watch, belt, scarf, sunglasses, or other fashion accessory

other.detection_hint: any product that doesn't clearly fit the categories above

material_visual_map.linen: visible woven texture, natural fibers, slightly irregular surface
material_visual_map.satin: smooth reflective surface, soft sheen, flowing drape
material_visual_map.velvet: dense soft pile, light-dependent surface variation
material_visual_map.silk: smooth lustrous surface with a subtle natural sheen, fluid drape
material_visual_map.wool: soft dense fibers with visible natural texture, warm matte finish
material_visual_map.leather: supple grained surface with natural variation, soft sheen where light hits
material_visual_map.shilajit: dark resin/mineral-like ingredient, glossy near-black surface
material_visual_map.ashwagandha: dried, pale tan-brown root pieces with a rough natural texture
material_visual_map.turmeric: vivid golden-orange powder or fresh root with a matte, earthy surface
material_visual_map.ginger: pale tan, knobby fresh root with a fibrous natural texture
material_visual_map.moringa: fine vivid-green powder or fresh green leaf sprigs
material_visual_map.ghee: translucent golden liquid or soft semi-solid with a warm glossy sheen
material_visual_map.collagen: fine white to pale powder, or a clear/lightly tinted liquid
material_visual_map.aloe vera: thick translucent gel with a cool, glossy, slightly green-tinted surface
material_visual_map.green tea: small dried dark-green leaves or pale green infused liquid
